answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 19300 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: please suggest me any dua as my wife doesnt perform namaz Question: Assalamualykum, please suggest me any dua as my wife doesnt perform namaz so i can recite that dua for her to be regular in namaz. Thanks Answer ID: 19300 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 158/138/L=1431) Recite the below-mentioned dua excessively: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا Start reading Fazail Aamal in the house, in-shaAllah, she will soon begin performing salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
